metadata.description: Free note-taking and writing skills for AI assistants, by interest, by method, and for everyday notes and writing. From Scratchpad, the notes app at https://scratchpad.sh.

plugins.name: note-taking-methods
plugins.description: The established ways to take notes, from Cornell notes and the Zettelkasten to mind maps, charting, and the Feynman technique.

plugins.name: notes-by-interest
plugins.description: Notes shaped for what you do: students, teachers, researchers, photographers, cooks, gardeners, botanists, musicians, writers, developers, math lovers, and more.

plugins.name: everyday-notes
plugins.description: Meetings, daily notes, weekly reviews, inboxes, and the everyday work of keeping notes tidy, findable, and useful.

plugins.name: writing
plugins.description: Turn notes into writing, then make it clear, short, and yours: essays, posts, emails, guides, fiction, and editing.
